prompt: A vertical 9:16 macro photograph of a handmade stop-motion miniature set: a tiny civil-service desk built from real balsa and dark-stained card, a felt blotter, a thumbnail-sized brass lamp with a warm LED glow. A small paper envelope, hand-cut and slightly wonky, hangs mid-drop on a visible thread just above the desk. It reads "O.H.M.S." with a hand-painted crest of a crowned key between two herons, and a red stamp painted in careful block letters reading exactly "APPROVED BY THE CONSERVATIVE PARTY". Fingerprints in the plasticine paperweight, dust on the set, shallow depth of field from a 100mm macro lens, a painted Whitehall window backdrop out of focus behind. Thanks.
